title: App Directory Record
description: Reply to `fdc3.discoverability.discoverAppDirectoryRecord` on app channel `fdc3.discoverability`. Embeds one FDC3 App Directory `Application` record (imported from the App Directory specification), or an error when `appId` is unknown.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: Echo of the requested App Directory `appId`.

record.title: Application
record.description: Full FDC3 App Directory `Application` record (`appId`, `title`, `type`, `details`, optional `interop`, `hostManifests`, …).

error.title: Error
error.description: Present when no App Directory record was found; `record` is omitted.

examples.error: No App Directory record for appId unknown.app
